case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Informed, purpose-limited collection and lawful course-end memory restriction/disposal, with access and security protections.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: Although N084 establishes purpose limitation, collection notices, security, and access/correction, it does not specify operational course-end AI memory restriction or disposal or reconcile nominal course-end deletion with WA State Records Act retention schedules.
case_summary.case_note: Murdoch's Privacy Policy (N083) and Privacy Procedure (N084) establish purpose limitation, collection notices, 30-day access and correction, security safeguards, and Privacy Officer oversight. However, they do not specify operational course-end memory restriction or deletion for a single-course AI learning assistant or reconcile it with State Records Act retention (N084, 9.3), leaving a critical gap. Protocol v1.1 was adopted after preliminary review on 2026-11-15, and this proposal awaits human verification.
